templates.why_chosen: A star example: a dashed allocator hub on top with two colour-coded resource pools, bold red Control Path arrows fanning down to Host 1 ... Host N spokes sharing one identical internal template.
templates.what_to_learn: Give the hub a dashed boundary and colour its internal resource pools by type (orange SSD, teal NIC), then draw only Host 1 and Host N with an ellipsis between, each an identical Instance-plus-Engine box, and put the fan-out arrows in one bold accent colour.

templates.why_chosen: Star, high-confidence nested-stack exemplar: the dashed Pod-Wide Allocator box nests a Logical SSD Pool and a Logical NIC Pool, each nesting Free, Allocated and Failed sub-boxes, in just 7 components and depth 3.
templates.what_to_learn: Split a shared allocator into side-by-side same-shape sub-pools, each nesting the identical three-state vocabulary, free, allocated, failed, so the two resource types stay visually parallel, and reserve one bold colour for the control-path arrows leaving the whole nested block.
